notes: 遊戲本體角色、Paladin 與 HUNK 皮膚的說明文字。

COMMANDO_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: Experimental WASP armor. Comes complete with onboard AI and biofoam systems. Only worn by the most elite of soldiers.
COMMANDO_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 實驗性的WASP裝甲。配備完整的機載AI與生物泡沫系統。只有最精銳的士兵才能穿上。

COMMANDO_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: Custom-made decorative MARCH Mk. III variant. The terms of the pact made by those reborn in the eye of the storm are unknown.
COMMANDO_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 特別訂製的MARCH Mk. III裝飾款。那些在風暴之眼中重生的人究竟立下了什麼契約，無人知曉。

MERC_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: A gift from a rival Europian noble, for a job well done.
MERC_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 來自一位敵對的歐羅巴貴族的禮物，感謝他出色地完成了任務。

MERC_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: Don't ask where that scar came from. He'll never admit it.
MERC_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 別問那道疤是怎麼來的。他永遠不會承認。

ENGI_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: EOD isn't stressful. Either I'm right, or suddenly it's not my problem anymore.
ENGI_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 拆彈一點都不緊張。要嘛我做對了，要嘛這突然就不再是我的問題了。

ENGI_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: Because people need to know you're not ''an Engineer,'' you're ''THE Engineer.''
ENGI_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 因為大家得知道，你不是「一名工程師」，你是「那位工程師」。

HUNTRESS_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: Blinding snowdrifts conceal the arrow that will darken your sight forevermore.
HUNTRESS_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 令人睜不開眼的雪堆，藏著那支將讓你永遠失去光明的箭。

HUNTRESS_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: Make the treeline your personal hunting platform.
HUNTRESS_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 把樹梢變成你專屬的狩獵平臺。

MAGE_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: The House holds many gifts for those it deems worthy.
MAGE_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 對於它認可的人，家族備有許多贈禮。

MAGE_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: Bearing the brunt of the storm can be eye-opening.
MAGE_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 首當其衝地承受風暴，可能會讓人大開眼界。

TOOLBOT_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: NOW YOU CAN APPLY GREAT FORCE TO COMBATANTS, TOO.
TOOLBOT_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 現在你也可以對戰鬥人員施加巨大的力量了。

TOOLBOT_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: The Storm hides many wonders, notably chrome detailing.
TOOLBOT_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 風暴中藏著許多奇觀，尤其是鍍鉻的細節。

TREEBOT_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: Even treebots change colors in Autumn.
TREEBOT_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 就連樹木機器人到了秋天也會變色。

TREEBOT_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: Once the Storm subsided, we discovered dozens of specimens of new flora across the planet.
TREEBOT_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 風暴平息之後，我們在這顆星球各處發現了數十種新植物的標本。

LOADER_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: The construction yellow and hazard stripes mean it's safe, right?
LOADER_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 工程黃加上警示條紋，代表它很安全，對吧？

LOADER_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: 250 tons was the limit for the old suit. That's child's play after the upgrades.
LOADER_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 250噸是舊款機甲的極限。升級之後，那只是小菜一碟。

CROCO_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: Ages spent in the Cells tends to leave one looking pale.
CROCO_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 在牢房中度過漫長歲月，難免顯得蒼白。

CROCO_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 「船長？我覺得我們的狗突變了。」

CAPTAIN_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: A promotion he declined, a desk he didn't want to sit behind the rest of his career.
CAPTAIN_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 一次他婉拒的升遷，一張他不想在餘下職涯中一直坐在後面的辦公桌。

CAPTAIN_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: A title from a life unlived, never sailing the void.
CAPTAIN_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 來自另一段未曾活過的人生的頭銜，從未航行於虛空。

BANDIT2_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: It was here. He was HERE. I start clawing, my razor sharp bones raking the plaster apart. It was here. I'm so cold.
BANDIT2_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 它就在這裡。他就在「這裡」。我開始抓刨，銳利如剃刀的骨頭把灰泥耙得四分五裂。它就在這裡。我好冷。

BANDIT2_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: Bought with the proceeds from ill-gotten gains instead of paying off creditors.
BANDIT2_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 用不義之財的收益買的，而不是拿去還債。

RAILGUNNER_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 可惜，這架無人機無法運作。

RAILGUNNER_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: What need is there to be stealthy when you're outside detection range?
RAILGUNNER_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 既然你在偵測範圍之外，又何必隱匿行蹤？

VOIDSURVIVOR_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: All is dark and quiet now.
VOIDSURVIVOR_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 現在一切都黑暗而寂靜。

VOIDSURVIVOR_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.en: Her golden embrace helps to quiet its influence.
VOIDSURVIVOR_SKIN_ALT2_DESC.zh-TW: 她金色的擁抱有助於平息它的影響。

FALSESON_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: His light can burn through even the deepest corruption.
FALSESON_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 他的光芒甚至能燒穿最深沉的腐化。

CHEF_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.en: More appropriate attire for such an accomplished CHEF unit.
CHEF_SKIN_ALT1_DESC.zh-TW: 對於如此出色的大廚機型而言，這是更合適的裝束。

PALADINBODY_DEFAULT_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 這名倖存者的預設皮膚。

PALADINBODY_LUNAR_SKIN_DESC.en: Righteous Underling to Mithrix's demands. Wrathful, yet stoic.
PALADINBODY_LUNAR_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 聽命於米斯歷克斯的正義部下。憤怒，卻又堅忍。

PALADINBODY_LUNARKNIGHT_SKIN_DESC.en: Ancient History is sometimes worth looking into once more.
PALADINBODY_LUNARKNIGHT_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 古老的歷史有時值得再回顧一次。

PALADINBODY_TYPHOON_SKIN_DESC.en: Many cycles after The Fall, mission unforgotten, only delayed. Valiant, yet tired.
PALADINBODY_TYPHOON_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 隕落之後歷經無數輪迴，使命未曾遺忘，只是延宕。英勇，卻已疲憊。

PALADINBODY_TYPHOONLEGACY_SKIN_DESC.en: It never hurts to take a peek at the past.
PALADINBODY_TYPHOONLEGACY_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 回頭看看過去，從來不是壞事。

PALADINBODY_POISON_SKIN_DESC.en: Brooding Cultist to N'Kuhana's calling. Unhinged, yet focused.
PALADINBODY_POISON_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 回應恩庫哈納召喚的陰鬱信徒。癲狂，卻又專注。

PALADINBODY_POISONLEGACY_SKIN_DESC.en: Oldschool origins, we all gotta start from somewhere.
PALADINBODY_POISONLEGACY_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 老派的起點，誰都得從某個地方開始。

PALADINBODY_CLAY_SKIN_DESC.en: Tar given purpose beyond Gestalt. Quiet, yet unstable.
PALADINBODY_CLAY_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 被賦予了超越集合意識之使命的焦油。安靜，卻不穩定。

PALADINBODY_SPECTER_SKIN_DESC.en: An ancient member of an Order from a far off land. Known as the Specter of Torment to some.
PALADINBODY_SPECTER_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 來自遙遠國度某個騎士團的古老成員。有些人稱之為折磨幽魂。

PALADINBODY_DRIP_SKIN_DESC.en: No Gods, No Masters, only the grind, the bag, and the motion.
PALADINBODY_DRIP_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 沒有神，沒有主人，只有苦幹、賺錢與行動。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_DEFAULT_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 這名倖存者的預設皮膚。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_CLASSIC_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 《惡靈古堡2 重製版》的模型。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_TOFU_SKIN_DESC.en: Low in calories, high in protein, and just the man for the mission.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_TOFU_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 低熱量、高蛋白，正是這項任務的不二人選。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SUPER_SKIN_DESC.en: Thanks so much for your support and/or congratulations on cheating! As a reward and/or joke, you can have every power.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SUPER_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 非常感謝你的支持，或者恭喜你作弊成功！作為獎勵，或者說玩笑，你可以擁有所有能力。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_LIGHTWEIGHT_SKIN_DESC.en: OSP? Of course. This is a top-secret black op. Don't expect any official support.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_LIGHTWEIGHT_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: OSP？當然。這是最高機密的秘密行動。別指望任何官方支援。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_GUERRILLA_SKIN_DESC.en: 'I have a job to do, and I'm gonna see it through.' -Chris Redfield
ROB_HUNK_BODY_GUERRILLA_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 「我有任務在身，而且我會貫徹到底。」——克里斯．雷德菲爾

ROB_HUNK_BODY_ROOKIE_SKIN_DESC.en: 'Something tells me he's not a cop...' -Leon S. Kennedy.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_ROOKIE_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 「直覺告訴我，他不是警察……」——里昂．S．甘迺迪

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SWAT_SKIN_DESC.en: Your ass is a long way from Raccoon City, officer. Good luck.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SWAT_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 你離拉昆市可遠得很，警官。祝你好運。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_LEON_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 「大家都上哪去了？玩賓果嗎？」——里昂．S．甘迺迪

ROB_HUNK_BODY_ENFORCER_SKIN_DESC.en: Umbrella Corp. denies all affiliation with the Special Armed Garrison. Resemblance to Kerberos Protect Gear is entirely coincidental and non-actionable.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_ENFORCER_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 保護傘公司否認與特殊武裝駐防部隊有任何關聯。與Kerberos護甲的相似之處純屬巧合，不構成訴訟理由。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_WESKER_SKIN_DESC.en: 'Seven minutes. Seven minutes is all I can spare to play with you.' -Albert Wesker
ROB_HUNK_BODY_WESKER_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 「七分鐘。我只能抽出七分鐘陪你玩。」——亞伯特．威斯克

ROB_HUNK_BODY_COMMANDO_SKIN_DESC.en: Standard issue MARCH Mk. III Commando armor. The yellow dome is the iconic face of UES enforcement.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_COMMANDO_SKIN_DESC.zh-TW: 制式的MARCH Mk. III指揮官裝甲。黃色圓頂是尤伊思執法部隊的標誌性面孔。
